report: 跨资产相关性异常雷达 — 2026Q3

market_context.fed_policy: Constrained between financial stability and inflation control
market_context.key_theme: Positive stock-bond correlation regime re-emerging — portfolio diversification eroding

anomalies.title: 黄金与比特币同步暴跌 — 15年未见
anomalies.detection: Charlie Bilello: gold and bitcoin are the ONLY major asset classes in the red in 2026. S&P 500 +9%, small caps +19%, value +15% YTD — all positive except these two.
anomalies.interpretation: Gold从$5,589高点回落至~$4,800，但同比仍+46%。BTC从$126K高点腰斩至$58.9K。两者同时成为2026年唯二负收益资产，在15年数据中首次出现。传统的'安全避风港'叙事在2026年失效——高实际利率+强美元双重压制。
anomalies.implication: If this persists, the 'risk-off = buy gold, buy bitcoin' narrative is structurally challenged. Gold's safe-haven role may need re-rating; bitcoin's correlation to liquidity cycle is dominant.

anomalies.title: 股债正相关性回归 — 40年纪录即将打破
anomalies.detection: Oxford Economics (Oct 2025) 准确预测2026年股债相关性转正。J.P. Morgan Mid-Year 2026 确认结构性升高。Wellington Management指出：1998年前的负相关是历史异常，而非常态。

data.correlation_observation: SPY +16%与TLT +1.5%同向，虽非高度正相关但已不再是负相关

anomalies.interpretation: 1998-2020年的股债负相关（60/40组合有效的核心支柱）正在瓦解。通胀波动加大+财政激进+地缘供给 shocks 推高期限溢价，使债券无法在股票下跌时提供对冲。
anomalies.implication: 60/40组合的有效性面临自1980年代以来最大挑战。替代对冲资产（黄金、商品、另类投资）需求结构性上升。Risk parity策略需重新校准。

anomalies.title: 商品与股票罕见脱钩 — 油气暴跌 vs 股市新高
anomalies.detection: 原油(USO)一个月暴跌-17.5%，能源板块(XLE)三个月暴跌-13%，而SPY三个月+16%、QQQ三个月+28.5%。商品与权益的同步性消失。
anomalies.interpretation: 油价>$100但能源股暴跌——市场在定价'通胀见顶+需求衰退'的预期。同时科技股暴涨44%（3个月），显示资金从周期/商品涌入AI/科技。这是典型的'宽顶后分化'模式。
anomalies.implication: 能源股可能在计价过度悲观。如果油价维持>$100，能源板块盈利仍强劲，当前的负背离可能是均值回归机会。但若衰退预期兑现，能源将继续承压。

anomalies.title: 黄金的夏季低迷比往常更深 — 但历史模式暗示反弹
anomalies.detection: WGC: gold entered summer doldrums with 11.7% monthly decline — the worst June in recent memory. Gold miners typically amplify gold moves 2-3x. Seasonally, gold's autumn rally starts mid-July.

data.seasonal_pattern: Summer weakness June-early July, then autumn rally from mid-July

anomalies.interpretation: 黄金从$5,589的历史高点回撤约14%。WGC的cross-asset分析指出：stock-bond正相关性将结构性支撑黄金需求（作为替代对冲）。$5,000的期权定价概率>30%。
anomalies.implication: 当前的弱势可能是2010s以来最好的黄金买入窗口之一——如果stock-bond正相关确实成为新常态。黄金的inflation hedging demand会结构性上升。

anomalies.title: 白银崩溃 — 比黄金惨烈近2倍
anomalies.detection: 白银一个月暴跌-21.75%，三个月-12%，远超黄金的跌幅。金银比急剧扩大。

data.gold_silver_ratio_change: 白银跌幅是黄金的1.86倍（1个月）

anomalies.interpretation: 白银兼具货币属性+工业属性，工业需求预期走弱（衰退交易）加剧了白银的下跌。金银比突破历史均值，历史上在金银比高位时做多白银有均值回归倾向。
anomalies.implication: 极端金银比暗示白银可能超卖。若黄金反弹，白银的弹性更大（通常2-3倍黄金涨幅）。但需等待工业需求触底信号。

anomalies.title: 比特币 — 从'数字黄金'到'流动性β'的证伪
anomalies.detection: 2026年比特币表现(-27%)比黄金(-3%)差9倍，彻底打破了'数字黄金'叙事。QQQ +20% YTD，BTC -27%，btc-qqq 背离达到 47ppt。
anomalies.interpretation: 比特币在2026年被证明是高流动性周期的杠杆β——当流动性收紧时表现劣于所有资产。'数字黄金'叙事在2026年遭遇了最严重的信任危机。
anomalies.implication: BTC的safe-haven claim需要根本性修正。它更像高β科技股而非黄金。在portfolio context中，它目前的角色是'极高波动性的流动性投机工具'而非'价值储存'。

cross_asset_correlation_matrix.gold_equity: NEGATIVE (normal — gold falling as stocks rise)
cross_asset_correlation_matrix.gold_bond: NEGATIVE-TO-NEUTRAL (both fell together briefly then diverged)
cross_asset_correlation_matrix.oil_equity: NEGATIVE (unusual — oil down, stocks up sharply)
cross_asset_correlation_matrix.btc_equity: NEGATIVE (btc crashing while stocks rally — correlation breakdown)
cross_asset_correlation_matrix.usd_gold: NEGATIVE (strong USD pressuring gold — classic but amplified)

regime_assessment.current_regime: Late-cycle equity rally with inflation hangover
regime_assessment.risk_parity_implication: RISK — positive stock-bond correlation means 60/40 is no longer self-hedging
regime_assessment.diversification_note: Out of 10. Bonds no longer hedge equity risk adequately. Gold and commodities also failing as diversifiers in 2026. Cash and select alts are the only true diversifiers.
regime_assessment.most_anomalous_signal: Gold + Bitcoin being the ONLY two negative asset classes in a year when everything else is up — 15-year unprecedented pattern

trade_implications.idea: Gold dip-buy ahead of autumn seasonal rally
trade_implications.rationale: Stock-bond positive correlation → structural gold demand. -11.7% monthly drop is extreme. Seasonal pattern favors rally from mid-July. WGC confirms gold remains best diversifier in high-SBC regime.

trade_implications.idea: Silver mean reversion (long silver vs short gold)
trade_implications.rationale: 金银比处于极端高位。白银工业需求风险犹存，但一旦黄金反弹，白银弹性更大。需催化剂（中国刺激、PMI回升）。

trade_implications.idea: Energy vs tech pair trade (long XLE, short XLK)
trade_implications.rationale: 能源与科技的43ppt 3个月背离不可持续。油价>$100支撑能源盈利，但AI动能仍在。适合作为均值回归的tail hedge。
SBC正相关是结构性的而非周期性的。债券作为对冲工具的效率正在永久性降低。WGC、JPM、Oxford Economics一致认同。

trade_implications.idea: Bitcoin — avoid as safe haven, monitor as liquidity gauge
trade_implications.rationale: BTC 2026年表现彻底否定其'数字黄金'叙事。但它仍是全球流动性状况的领先指标——BTC企稳可能预示风险偏好回归。
